Class TiltState

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.subsystems.swerve.TiltState
public final class TiltState extends Object
What the Pigeon says about the robot's attitude and knocks, derived from logged inputs so it replays. Used by odometry (tilt scaling), vision gating (sources that assume a level robot), and available to shot gating (Swerve.isTilted(), Swerve.wasBumpedRecently()).
  • Tilt: the angle between the robot's up axis and vertical, from pitch and roll.
  • Impact: how far the total measured acceleration is from 1 g. Standing, driving smoothly or tilted it stays near 0 (gravity is 1 g in any orientation); a collision, a bump or landing off one shows as a spike, whatever the direction.
  • Odometry scale (6328's addOdometryObservation, issue #10 section 8g): 1 while level, falling linearly to 0 between TILT_DEADBAND_DEG and TILT_ZERO_DEG. On a bump the wheels slip, lift or roll up a slope, so their travel overstates the robot's motion across the floor.
